title: Quản trị các nguồn lực thông tin
duration: 3 tín chỉ (45 giờ tín chỉ; 50 phút/giờ)

skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Apply management of all information resources in economic and social organizations, especially in businesses.
Analyze and evaluate processes for upgrading, managing, and protecting information resources in organizations.
Develop skills in strategic planning for information systems in organizations.
Integrate knowledge and skills to assist leadership in effectively managing information resources.
Organize functional units for managing information resources in organizations.
Use information management systems to enhance economic efficiency and competitiveness.
Implement basic content of information technology investment, appraise and review IT investment projects.
Work independently or actively and effectively in group activities.
Demonstrate social responsibility and professional ethics in the field of information management systems.
Manage information security and address ethical challenges in information systems.
